# Validation Checklist: CoreUI UI Foundation (SPEC-0009)

**Purpose**: Production-grade validation gate for the CoreUI/VisaFusion UI
integration. Every item defines a verification method, expected result,
failure condition, and required evidence. The checklist **MUST prevent
declaring CoreUI integration complete when role-based native pages or
components remain unmapped** (see CHK-GATE-001/002 and NATIVE PAGES /
COMPONENTS sections).
**Created**: 2026-08-19
**Feature**: [specs/009-coreui-ui-foundation/spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Legend**: `[Spec §X]` = spec section · `[Plan §X]` = plan section ·
`[Research D-X]` = research decision · `[Mapping §X]` =
`docs/ui/COREUI_VISA_FUSION_MAPPING.md` · `[NavMatrix §X]` =
`docs/ui/ROLE_NAVIGATION_MATRIX.md` · `[Addendum §X]` =
`library/Role-Based Native Pages Architecture Addendum.md` ·
`[GAP-X]` = `docs/analysis/GAP_REPORT.md`

---

## GATE — Unmapped Pages / Components (MANDATORY, blocks completion)

- [ ] CHK-GATE-001 - Are ALL 41 native pages accounted for in the mapping with
  a CoreUI target and a status other than UNKNOWN?
  - **Verification**: Diff `docs/ui/COREUI_VISA_FUSION_MAPPING.md` §1–§6 rows
    against the 41-page inventory (`ROLE_BASED_NATIVE_PAGES_INVENTORY.md` §2);
    confirm every row has a non-empty CoreUI equivalent and a status from
    {IMPLEMENTED, MAPPED, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, NOT_REQUIRED}.
  - **Expected**: 41/41 pages present; 0 rows with empty CoreUI target; 0 rows
    with status UNKNOWN.
  - **Failure**: Any page missing from the mapping, any empty CoreUI target,
    or any UNKNOWN status → integration is NOT complete.
  - **Evidence**: Updated mapping doc with 41 rows; per-page status column;
    glob output of `src/VisaFusion.Web/**/*.cshtml` (41 files).

- [x] CHK-GATE-002 - Are ALL reusable VisaFusion components mapped to a CoreUI
  equivalent with one canonical implementation each?
  - **Verification**: Cross-check the 14 components in
    `COREUI_VISA_FUSION_MAPPING.md` §1–§7 against the partials under
    `src/VisaFusion.Web/Components/` and `Pages/Shared/`; confirm each has a
    CoreUI equivalent and exactly one implementation.
  - **Expected**: 14/14 components exist as canonical partials; 0 duplicated
    implementations; 0 components without a CoreUI target.
  - **Failure**: Any component missing, duplicated, or unmapped → integration
    is NOT complete.
  - **Evidence**: Component inventory table; glob of `Components/*.cshtml` and
    `Pages/Shared/_*.cshtml`; grep for duplicate partial names.
  - **Verified 2026-08-20 (T026)**: 14/14 components exist (10 partials in
    `Components/` + RoleAwareNavigation service + DesignTokens/ComponentStyles/
    IconSet assets); `CoreUIComponentTests.No_Duplicate_Component_Partials_Anywhere_In_Repo`
    asserts exactly one copy of each partial repo-wide; mapping doc §10 lists
    every component with its CoreUI equivalent.

- [ ] CHK-GATE-003 - Does the preservation gate (Addendum §18) pass in full?
  - **Verification**: Walk the 15 gate items in Addendum §18 against the
    delivered state (roles, permissions, pages, navigation, landing pages,
    workflows, routes, APIs, role-aware nav/breadcrumbs, migrated pages,
    role-based tests, KG, SpecKit, traceability).
  - **Expected**: All 15 items satisfied; no item left as "pending" or "to be
    regenerated".
  - **Failure**: Any gate item unchecked → completion declaration blocked.
  - **Evidence**: Completed Addendum §18 checklist in the feature docs.

## REPOSITORY

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the feature branch `009-coreui-ui-foundation` created from
  the correct base and does it contain only this feature's changes?
  - **Verification**: `git log --oneline -10` on the branch; `git diff
    main...009-coreui-ui-foundation --stat`; confirm no business/API/DB files
    outside the approved touch list (plan §Project Structure).
  - **Expected**: Branch exists; diff limited to `VisaFusion.Web` presentation,
    tests, docs, KG, and spec artifacts.
  - **Failure**: Changes to `VisaFusion.Core`/`Data`/`Api`/`Identity`/`Jobs`/
    `Migration` business code, or to the database schema.
  - **Evidence**: Git diff stat; changed-file list.

- [x] CHK002 - Are vendored CoreUI assets committed to the repository (not
  git-ignored or CDN-referenced)?
  - **Verification**: `git ls-files src/VisaFusion.Web/wwwroot/lib` and
    `wwwroot/icons`; grep `.cshtml` for external CDN URLs.
  - **Expected**: All vendored assets tracked; 0 CDN references (spec NFR-001).
  - **Failure**: Assets untracked, or any `https://` CDN link in layouts.
  - **Evidence**: `git ls-files` output; grep results.

- [ ] CHK003 - Is the repository buildable and deployable at every commit of
  this feature (constitution Mission)?
  - **Verification**: `dotnet build VisaFusion.sln` at each phase commit
    (A–F); CI build on the branch.
  - **Expected**: Build green at every commit; CI green on the PR.
  - **Failure**: Any commit that does not build.
  - **Evidence**: CI run logs; local build output.

## COREUI

- [x] CHK004 - Is the adopted CoreUI version pinned and documented (v5.6.0,
  commit `d4003cd`)?
  - **Verification**: `wwwroot/lib/README.md` records source commit + package
    versions; compare against `COREUI_DEPENDENCY_MAP.md` §8.
  - **Expected**: Version pin documented; matches the reference copy.
  - **Failure**: No pin record, or version differs from the reference.
  - **Evidence**: `wwwroot/lib/README.md`; `package.json` of the reference copy.

- [x] CHK005 - Are only the needed CoreUI assets vendored (no demo-only
  content, no PRO assets, no `examples.css`)?
  - **Verification**: List `wwwroot/lib/*` and `wwwroot/icons/*`; grep for
    `examples.css`, `docs-components`, PRO links.
  - **Expected**: No demo-only or PRO artifacts; icon set limited to used
    `cil-*`/`cif-*` (spec §6; `COREUI_INVENTORY.md` §5, §9, §11).
  - **Failure**: Demo/PRO content present, or full 524-icon copy without
    justification.
  - **Evidence**: Asset inventory; grep results.

- [x] CHK006 - Is the CoreUI dependency set non-duplicated (single vendored
  Bootstrap/CoreUI, no AdminLTE)?
  - **Verification**: Grep `wwwroot` and `.csproj` for `adminlte`, duplicate
    `bootstrap`/`coreui` copies.
  - **Expected**: One CoreUI set; 0 AdminLTE references (constitution
    Engineering Process & Security Standards).
  - **Failure**: Duplicate framework assets or AdminLTE present.
  - **Evidence**: Grep results; asset tree.
